ns2:section.sectionText: Title: Storytelling and Transformation: Narratives of Self from Homer to Arianna Huffington In this course, we explore ways individuals, groups, societies, and countries locate themselves in the world through storytelling. The course includes examples from the Greek, Roman and Hellenistic traditions as well as popular culture in the United States today. Readings include but not limited to Homer, Plato, Foucault, Kazantzakis, Cavafy, Newman, Michalopoulou.
